results.question: Which customers are based in Europe?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON c.region = r.region WHERE r.country = 'Europe'

results.question: I need every product that falls under Software.
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM products p INNER JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Software'

results.question: Give me the orders that were shipped.
results.generated_sql: SELECT o.* FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped'

results.question: Who are our SDRs?
results.generated_sql: SELECT e.name AS sdr_name FROM employees e INNER JOIN customers c ON e.region = c.region WHERE e.role = 'SDR' AND c.segment IN ('Enterprise', 'SMB')

results.question: Which payments are still pending?
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.payment_id, p.method, p.status, p.paid_at FROM payments p INNER JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.status = 'pending'

results.question: Pull up the SMB customers.
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.email, c.region, c.segment, c.signup_date FROM customers c WHERE c.segment = 'SMB'

results.question: Which orders came in online?
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.status, o.channel FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'online'

results.question: How many customers do we have?
results.generated_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers

results.question: Show me the refunded payments.
results.generated_sql: SELECT payment_id, order_id, amount, method, status, paid_at FROM payments WHERE status = 'refunded' LIMIT 100

results.question: Which employees work in the LATAM region?
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.name FROM employees AS e INNER JOIN customers AS c ON e.employee_id = c.sales_rep_credited WHERE c.region = 'LATAM'

results.question: How many orders are there in total?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS total_orders

results.question: What's the average product price?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(products.unit_price) AS avg_product_price FROM products

results.question: What is the total amount of all paid payments?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(payments.amount) AS total_paid_amount FROM payments WHERE payments.status = 'paid' AND payments.paid_at IS NOT NULL

results.question: How many orders do we have for each status?
results.generated_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status

results.question: Number of customers in each segment.
results.generated_sql: SELECT segment AS 'Segment', COUNT(*) AS 'Customer Count' FROM customers GROUP BY segment

results.question: What is the most expensive product we sell?
results.generated_sql: SELECT MAX(products.unit_price) AS max_expensive_product FROM products INNER JOIN order_items ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id

results.question: What is the average payment amount for each payment method?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.method AS payment_method, AVG(p.amount) AS avg_payment_amount FROM payments p GROUP BY p.method

results.question: How many employees do we have in each role?
results.generated_sql: SELECT role, COUNT(employee_id) AS num_employees FROM employees GROUP BY role

results.question: What is the total quantity sold per product category?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC

results.question: Count the orders by channel.
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.channel, COUNT(T1.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS T1 INNER JOIN order_items AS T3 ON T1.order_id = T3.order_id INNER JOIN payments AS T4 ON T1.order_id = T4.order_id GROUP BY T2.channel

results.question: What is the largest discount ever given on an order item?
results.generated_sql: SELECT MAX(discount_pct) AS max_discount FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM orders)

results.question: How many payments have failed?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_failed_payments FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed'

results.question: What is the average unit cost of our Electronics products?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(products.unit_cost) AS avg_unit_cost FROM products WHERE products.category = 'Electronics'

results.question: Which customers have cancelled orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS customer_name FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' ORDER BY c.name

results.question: Names of the employees who handled online orders.
results.generated_sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e INNER JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE o.channel = 'online'

results.question: What products were bought by SMB customers?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name FROM products p INNER JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE segment = 'SMB')

results.question: Show the payment method used for each delivered order.
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.method FROM payments AS p INNER JOIN orders AS o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.method

results.question: List the customers who paid with PayPal.
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.name, c.email FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.method = 'paypal'

results.question: Which product categories did Enterprise customers buy?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.category AS product_category FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY count(*) DESC

results.question: Which sales managers handled returned orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT e.name AS manager_name FROM employees e INNER JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' OR o.status = 'returned'

results.question: Customers from LATAM who ordered by phone.
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, c.email, o.status, o.channel FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.channel = 'phone' AND c.region = 'LATAM'

results.question: What is the total revenue per customer region?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.region AS region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct/100.0)) AS total_revenue FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

results.question: How many orders has each employee handled?
results.generated_sql: SELECT e.name AS employee_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM employees e LEFT JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY order_count DESC

results.question: What is the average quantity per order item for each product category?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, AVG(oi.quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC

results.question: Which customers have had a payment refunded?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.name, c.email FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN payments AS p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.status = 'refunded' LIMIT 10
